pageDescription: Find identical files across an entire drive or inside a specific folder. Before deleting, check each copy’s location: identical files may be used by different apps or tasks.
wholeDriveHint: The scan checks the selected drive. Essential Windows and installed-program folders are skipped for safety; the minimum size and filters still apply.
drivesLoadFailed: Could not list this computer’s drives.
confirmRecycleDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be moved to the recycle bin.
confirmPermanentDesc: {{count}} files ({{size}}) will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
keepOneCopy: At least one copy must be kept
hardLinkedCopy: Other hard links keep this file, so deleting it would free no space
emptyDescription: No duplicate files were found with the current settings.
idleDescription: Select a directory to scan for duplicate files and reclaim wasted disk space.
scanCancelled: Scan was cancelled — showing partial results.
